records.title: Appropriate Measures to Regulate Airfare in the Country
details:
माननीय अध्यक्ष : यह उम्मीद है कि मंत्री जी उस पर पूरा ऐक्शन लेंगे। आपने जो-जो विषय उठाए हैं, मंत्री जी उन पर बिल्कुल ऐक्शन लेंगे।
मंत्री जी, जो-जो विषय उस समय उठे थे और आज माननीय सदस्य ने जो विषय उठाए हैं, आप सारे एयरलाइंस वालों को बुलाइए और उन पर ऐक्शन लीजिए।
नागर विमानन मंत्री : सर, जरूर करेंगे।

records.title: EXORBITANT RISE IN AIR FARE
details: It is a suggestion being given by the Hon. Member. We will definitely look into it.

records.title: EXORBITANT RISE IN AIR FARE
details:
In fact, after I
took charge as the Minister of Civil Aviation, my immediate commitment to
the people of this country was to make the airfares affordable. I did not
know what was going through it. I was not aware of the rules, but I gave a
commitment to the people that we are going to make it affordable. I am
ensuring that. Whatever process can be involved in achieving this, we will
do it
